text:
harper: quick brain-dump: I'm proposing a compact+flag envelope to unify telemetry lanes but with explicit attribution tokens so billing/analytics can diverge downstream without re-parsing. idea is to keep the fastpath parser minimal and let materializers add high-card attrs. thoughts? :thought_balloon:
zane: love the idea of a single ingress surface, but +1 with caveats: billing determinism and late-join queries. we need a synchronous guarantee for billing_token -> billing_key mapping in the router or we'll break chargeback windows.
olina: suggest header layout: FAST (route, trace_id, billing_token?), POLICY (retention_hint, sample_hint), REF (body_ref, meta_ref, checksum). ensure p50 decode < 1ms.
miguel: tracing callout: if enrichment is async, we must preserve a stable trace_id in FAST so stitcher can join events later. also include an optional span_hint parent to reduce ambiguity when reconstructing.
harper: sketch I posted to the RFC draft:```json
{"fast":{"route":"us-east:ingest","trace":"t_7ffd","billing_tok":"btok_42","fast_ts":1710000000},"policy":{"retention":"long","sample_hint":false},"ref":{"body_ref":"gs://raw/2025/12/part-000.avro","checksum":"sha256:abcd..."}}
```
zane: retention semantics: historically analytics had 90d TTL and billing 365d. We must keep per-envelope retention_hint and ensure storage router honors it. Also add a canonical enum: short|standard|long.
olina: sampling behaviour: if sample_hint=true and no billing_tok -> sampled pipeline. if billing_tok present -> force full ingest and bypass sampling. Also include sample_override boolean for ops. This prevents double-counting when analytics sample.
miguel: operational concern: backfills. materializers must be idempotent using checksum+format_v and record materialization_time so we can reason about attribution windows. If we materialize late, billing attribution must not retroactively change prior invoices.
harper: infra note: we should keep a compact join-index (body_ref -> enriched_attrs) to serve ad-hoc queries without pulling full payloads into the main envelope. index TTL follows retention_hint.
infra-bot: created ticket: infra/obs/compact-envelope-3456789012 and scheduled perf bench: https://ci.redwood/obs/bench/3456789012. ETA 20h.
zane: metrics to monitor: billing_latency_p50/p95, parser_cpu_ms_p50, attr_cardinality_growth_rate, join-index-hit-rate, stitcher-latency. set alerts: billing_p95 > target OR attr_cardinality growth > 3x/baseline.
olina: migration plan proposal: 1) accept compact envelopes alongside lanes, 2) enable fastpath routing for non-billing tenants (5%), 3) promote cohorts after perf & SLO validation, 4) flip billing cohorts once join-index and materializers validated. rollback window: 1h for non-billing, 2h for billing.
miguel: I'll prototype sidecar injection for trace_id and a stitcher that consumes FAST headers + enrichments to emit consolidated spans.
harper: action items: I'll update RFC with header schema, retention enum, sampling override rules, join-index design, and migration checklist. @zane validate SLO deltas; @olina owns backfill plan; @miguel prototype stitcher. Tagging for Wed sync. :white_check_mark:
